text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

COAL - Queensland, Oct 8 - Abbot Point - one vessel loading, 1 waiting, 6 due by 14/11. Approx 1 days delay. Dalrymple Bay - maintenance shutdown 4-9/11. One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 15 due by 21/10. Approx 1 days delay. Hay Point - two vessels loading, 7 waiting, 10 due by 20/10. 3-4 days delay. Gladstone - R.G. Tanna 2 vessels loading, 28 due by 30/10. No delays. Barney Point no nominations due to major shutdown for upgrading terminal plant and equipment. First vessel scheduled for 8/11. Brisbane - berth vacant, 4 vessels due by 3/11, no delays.

New South Wales - Newcastle - Kooragang one coal loader gantry out for maintenance until 12/10. Two vessels loading, 3 waiting, 9 due by 15/10. 3-4 days delay. Dykes 4+5 1 vessel loading, 4 waiting, 9 due by 22/10. Approx 3-4 days delay. Port kembla - berth vacant 18 vessels due by 5/11 no delays.

IRON ORE - Western Australia - Port Hedland BHP iron ore pty. Mt. Newman (Nelson Point), A berth 6 vessels due by 18/10, B berth 1 vessel loading, 6 due by 16/10, 5 others due by 20/10. BHP iron ore - Goldsworthy (Finucane Is) 1 vessel due 14/10. Dampier - Parker Point 1 vessel loading, 1 anchored, 1 due by 8/10. East Intercourse Is 3 vessels due by 9/10. Dampier line-up 17 vessels due by 26/10 of which 12 for Parker Point, 5 for East Intercourse Is. Port Walcott - vessel loading, 12 due by 31/10.

GRAIN - Queensland - Mackay, two vessels due by 10/11 of which 1 to load wheat, 1 maize. Gladstone - four vessels due by early November of which 2 to load wheat, 1 sorghum, 1 peas. Globex expect 200,000 MT wheat for export prior to the end of the year. Brisbane - one vessel due 20/10 to load wheat.

New South Wales - Newcastle - two vessels due 28/10, both to load wheat. Port Kembla - three vessels due by November, all to load wheat. Shipments of new crop will start in December '96. Victoria - one vessel waiting to load wheat, 9 due by 28/10 of which 3 to load barley, 3 wheat, 2 oats, 1 peas. Portland - five due by 23/10 which 3 to load wheat, 1 barley, 1 safflower.

South Australia - Port Pirie - one vessel loading barley, 2 due by 14/10, both to load wheat. Port Adelaide - one vessel loading malt, 3 due by 17/10 of which 2 to load wheat, 1 barley. Thevenard, Port Lincoln, Port Giles, Ardrossan - no vessels due. Wallaroo - one vessel loading wheat.

Western Australia - Geraldton - one vessel due 12/10 to load wheat. Kwinana - one vessel loading barley, 4 due by 27/10 of which 3 to load wheat, 1 lupins/oats. Loading terminal has come to an agreement with unions and evening shifts as well as day now operating Monday-Friday. Albany - one vessel loading wheat, 6 due by 19/10 of which 4 to load wheat, 1 oats, 1 barley. Esperance - one vessel loading wheat, 1 due 18/10 to load wheat.
